working_definition: Posterior midgut epithelial cells in the Malpighian tubule analysis (Li et al. 2022; Manual Annotation, broad class epithelial cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell (FBbt:00000124) that is part of some adult midgut epithelium (FBbt:00007026).

justification: FBbt has no general adult posterior midgut epithelial cell term; only cell-type-specific posterior terms (enterocyte, enteroendocrine, ISC), none matching an unresolved regional group. The adult midgut epithelial cell is the most specific true parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Broad subdivision of the midgut; posteriormost of the three traditional sections.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Region term, not a cell term.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: enterocyte of posterior adult midgut epithelium
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A large, polyploid epithelial cell of the adult posterior midgut.
